scientific_role: same-network source-native signed-position triangulation; not independent validation and not historical causal identification

source_system.network_scope: 8 sites x 5 seasonal surveys in 2013 or 2014

source_identity_audit.rule: exact name or whitespace-only normalization; no fuzzy, family, guild or midpoint substitution

pollinator_community_centers.definition: visit-weighted mean proboscis length from 2017 Table S2; weights are all source-recorded pollinator visits at the stated site(s)

primary_source_regime.reason: the source study defines these three Honshu coastal sites as the continental comparison; pooling all source-recorded visits avoids choosing one mainland site after target inspection

prespecified_sensitivity_source_regime.reason: Oshima bridge-state sensitivity was already named in the pre-existing v12 empirical trait-position gate; it is not the primary source baseline

plant_starting_position.source_table: 2024 source-native data_sp_plant.csv from the same 40-network system; the 2024 article states that mean proboscis and corolla tube lengths were measured per species x site and the complete lengths were reported in the 2017 study
plant_starting_position.site_season_deduplication: one unique tube value per plant x site; repeated seasonal rows do not receive extra weight
plant_starting_position.source_trait: equal-weight mean tube_mm across unique continental plant x site observations
plant_starting_position.eligibility: plant species with >=1 continental site and >=1 Izu oceanic-island site in data_sp_plant

target_test_frozen_before_fit.response_definition: mean source-native plant species-level trait matching TM_sp at one Izu site across available seasons minus the plant's equal-weight mean TM_sp across continental plant x site units; higher TM_sp means better matching because TM_sp is the negative interaction-frequency-weighted absolute proboscis-tube mismatch
secondary_checks: continuous Pearson and Spearman association without island fixed effects
sign concordance between predicted_matching_change_mm and delta_TM_sp
Oshima-source-regime sensitivity where the required source plant observations exist
target_test_frozen_before_fit.failure_rule: A non-positive primary slope or sign-instability under island deletion is reported as failure of this community-center projection. Do not retune the baseline, midpoint, taxon mapping or response threshold after inspection.

shared_data_warning.reason: the public Table S2 supplies site-level pollinator visit totals but not plant x pollinator interaction counts; the legacy Dryad primary_data.xlsx metadata are public but file bytes remain HTTP 401/403 blocked
shared_data_warning.interpretation_ceiling: same-network mechanistic triangulation only; this cannot serve as independent held-out validation. The prospective Issue #91 field design remains the direct empirical gate.

forbidden_after_freeze: switching the primary mainland baseline after target inspection
using reproductive or pollen outcomes to choose the signed-position mapping
